parameters.name: attachments
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ color: $json.status === 'critical' ? 'danger' : $json.status === 'warning' ? 'warning' : 'good', fields: [{ title: 'Health Score', value: $json.overallHealthScore + '%', short: true }, { title: 'Active Connections', value: $json.details.connections.active, short: true }, { title: 'Memory Usage', value: Math.round($json.details.resources.memory.percentage) + '%', short: true }, { title: 'Alerts', value: $json.alerts.map(a => a.message).join('\n'), short: false }] }]) }}

parameters.name: html
parameters.value:
🚨 Critical Health Alert

Session: {{ $json.sessionId }}

Health Score: {{ $json.overallHealthScore }}%

Status: {{ $json.status }}

Alerts:

    {{ $json.alerts.map(a => '
  • ' + a.type + ': ' + a.message + '
    • ').join('') }}

Generated at: {{ $json.timestamp }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, message: 'Health check completed', sessionId: $json.sessionId, healthScore: $json.overallHealthScore, alertsSent: $json.alerts.length } }}
